name: The Cyber Boardroom
kicker: Cyber readiness for boards of directors
description: An independent brochure about The Cyber Boardroom, an AI cyber security advisor and content for boards of directors, made from its own public pages.
headline: Cyber security, explained to the board
lede: The Cyber Boardroom gives board members an AI cyber security advisor called Athena, short videos and curated articles, so they can understand their organisation's cyber security agenda and fulfil their duties as directors.

quote.q: Welcome to The Cyber Boardroom, the one-stop shop that boards of directors rely on for their cyber readiness.

what.t: The Cyber Boardroom is built for boards of directors. Its stated mission is "to help you understand your organisation's cyber security agenda, as well as fulfil your duties as a board member."
At its centre is Athena, an AI advisor built on large language models to answer board members' questions about cyber security and the risks their organisation faces.
Around Athena sit curated articles and a library of 60-second videos on key cyber security topics, which frame cyber security as "a risk management conversation", not an IT one.
The site is labelled "community edition" and "beta". A Community Edition can be installed with pip or Docker.

story.t: The Cyber Boardroom came from a question every director faces: what does cyber security mean for my organisation, and what should I do about it? Its own content answers that it is "a risk management conversation."

The first videos, introducing the platform and its advisor Athena, are dated February 2024. On 8 April 2024 its founder Dinis Cruz posted that "The Cyber Boardroom LTD has been created, it's official now".
In an interview published by SC Media UK on 22 April 2024, the platform was described as "serverless and driven by GenAI bots and agents".
July 2024 brought the first MVP write-up and the Community Edition, which anyone can install. The open-source packages behind the site kept being released until January 2025.
Today The Cyber Boardroom Limited, registered in the UK, is named on sgit.ai as the commercial vehicle behind sgit.ai and RiskMandate.ai.

for_whom.t: Boards of directors and individual board members.
Directors and executives who need to understand cyber risk without being technical, through CFO and CISO personas among others.
Anyone who wants to run it themselves: the Community Edition installs with pip or Docker.

how.title: Ask Athena
how.t: A board member asks a question; Athena, built on large language models, answers about cyber security only.

how.title: Make it yours
how.t: Board members personalise Athena by adding prompts in their profile.

how.title: Choose a model
how.t: The site works with several LLM platforms, including Groq, Mistral, OpenAI and Ollama.

how.title: Learn in minutes
how.t: Curated articles and 60-second videos cover the topics boards need.

products.name: Athena
products.t: "Your AI cyber security advisor", named after the Greek goddess of wisdom, courage and strategic warfare.

products.name: Curated content
products.t: Articles including Cyber security in the boardroom, Incident management and The importance of digital trust.

products.name: 60-second videos
products.t: A library of short videos on key cyber security topics.

products.name: Board personas
products.t: CFO and CISO personas to practise the conversation from each side.

products.name: Chat with LLMs
products.t: Try several large language models side by side, without a system prompt.

products.name: Community Edition
products.t: Install it yourself with pip or Docker; the packages are MIT licensed on PyPI.
